effects: The signer sends `amount` of the vault collateral to the vault through safeTransferFrom. For 0x4b7a… the collateral is uniBTC 0x004E9C3E…, per the constructor initData.
Active vault shares worth the deposited amount are credited to `onBehalfOf`, not necessarily the signer.
The deposit becomes slashable stake that the vault delegates.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 uniBTC from the signer into the named vault, with the shares credited to the beneficiary address.

findings.title: deposit: the uniBTC constant is unconfirmed as the collateral for 7 of the 8 deployments.
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.underlyingToken = 0x004E9C3E…, used in `#.amount` tokenAmount. Vault.sol deposit uses `IERC20(collateral).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount)`. `collateral` is set in _initialize from storage, and only 0x4b7a…'s initData (meta.json) confirms 0x004e9c3e…. The other 7 deployments have no meta.
findings.fix: Confirm on chain that collateral() returns uniBTC for every listed deployment. Move any vault with a different collateral into its own descriptor.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is not shown because it comes from vault storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_)` uses storage values that are not in the calldata.

effects: The signer's active shares are burned: previewWithdraw(amount), rounded up, which reverts if it is more than the signer holds.
The signer's active stake goes down by `amount` of collateral (uniBTC).
Withdrawal shares for `amount` in epoch currentEpoch+1 are credited to `claimer`. Only the claimer can claim them after that epoch ends, and they stay slashable until then.
No tokens move in this call.
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of 2.5 uniBTC from the vault, with the claim owned by the claimer address.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent does not say the funds wait for the next epoch or that the claimer, not the signer, claims them.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw: `uint256 epoch = currentEpoch() + 1; ... withdrawalSharesOf[epoch][claimer] += mintedShares;` and _claim checks `withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)`. The screen says "Request {amount} withdrawal for {claimer}" with the label 'Claim owner'.
findings.fix: An optional wording change: "Request {amount} withdrawal, claimable by {claimer} after the epoch ends".

effects: The signer's active shares are burned: exactly `shares`, which reverts if it is more than the signer holds.
The signer's active stake goes down by previewRedeem(shares) of collateral (uniBTC). The amount comes from the vault's stake-to-share ratio.
Withdrawal shares for that amount in the next epoch are credited to `claimer`, who can claim them after that epoch ends.
No tokens move in this call.
formats.shown: Queue a raw number of vault shares for withdrawal, with the claim owned by the claimer address.

findings.title: redeem: the shares appear as a raw integer, and the uniBTC amount they convert to is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares())`. The descriptor field `#.shares` has format raw. Case 9 shows '987654321123456789'.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor: the shares are internal accounting units, not an ERC-20, and the conversion depends on storage. The '(raw)' label is the honest choice.

effects: The signer's claim for `epoch` is marked as spent (isWithdrawalsClaimed[epoch][msg.sender] = true).
withdrawalsOf(epoch, signer) of collateral (uniBTC) is transferred from the vault to `recipient`, which may be someone other than the signer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal for epoch 42 and send it to the recipient address.

findings.title: claim: neither the intent nor the fields name the asset (uniBTC) that goes to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. The descriptor intent is "Claim withdrawal" and the interpolatedIntent is "Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}". No field mentions uniBTC.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent: "Claim uniBTC withdrawal" / "Claim uniBTC from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}".

findings.title: claim: the amount paid out comes from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _claim: `amount = withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)`, computed from the withdrawal share mappings.

effects: The signer's claims for every listed epoch are marked as spent. The call reverts if any of them is already claimed, empty or not finished.
The sum of withdrawalsOf(epoch, signer) over the listed epochs, in collateral (uniBTC), is transferred to `recipient` in one transfer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals for the listed epochs and send them to the recipient address.

findings.title: claimBatch: neither the intent nor the fields name the asset (uniBTC) that goes to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. The descriptor intent is "Claim withdrawals" and the interpolatedIntent is "Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}".
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent: "Claim uniBTC withdrawals" / "Claim uniBTC from epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}".

findings.title: claimBatch: the total amount paid out comes from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i])`, where _claim reads withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender).

couldNotCheck: The collateral token of 7 of the 8 deployments (0x5ab26316…, 0x5e278bf9…, 0x95934438…, 0x9fafca91…, 0xabe79b50…, 0xc50f8c3f…, 0xca5412f1…). Only 0x4b7a…'s source and initData are in the directory, so I can't confirm that the uniBTC constant used for every amount is the collateral those vaults actually move.
